text_block_list.text:
"A greater dream, filled with light. Reach 
out just a little further, and your 
fingertips will surely touch it."

Those days filled with such hope came to 
an abrupt end one day—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm off!
It came to a stop.

Dantsu Flame suddenly crouched down, 
clutching her leg. I rushed over, calmed 
her down as she tried to stand, and 
examined her leg—

It was severely swollen and burning hot to 
the touch.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I'm okay...! I... I'm still—!

Shaking my head at her words of "I can 
still run," I hurry straight to the 
hospital.

Please don't let it be anything serious. 
...Such prayers, however, were in vain—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
This is going to be difficult to hear, but 
her condition is not looking good.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
With proper recuperation, she will have no 
issues in daily life. She should even be 
able to run again.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However, wanting to enter a race is 
another matter entirely.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Especially in the Twinkle Series, which 
places some of the heaviest demands on a 
runner... even more so.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
If it worsens, it could interfere with 
your daily life. ...Unfortunately, I must 
say that continuing to race would be 
extremely difficult.

On the path I blindly dashed through, I 
suddenly ran into an impossibly massive 
wall.
My mind couldn't quite process the shock—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I-I'm not... retiring...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I can't. No matter what... I mean, I've 
finally made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you're saying. Winning 
the Takarazuka Kinen back then took 
everything—truly, everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
In the races ahead, I'll have to push my 
legs that hard... No, even harder than 
that, or I won't win.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The training load will keep increasing as 
well. Your concern over how much a body 
that was once broken can endure is 
completely justified.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Even so――

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame-san.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"There's no need to decide today. Please 
don't rush, and take the time to discuss 
it thoroughly between the two of you."
The walk home was quiet.

I thought I had been paying the utmost 
attention to her workload. Even so, I 
failed to notice any sign that something 
was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...No. I'm the one who should be 
apologizing."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There were a few times during solo 
training where I pushed myself too hard 
without realizing it. ...I even felt 
something was off.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still, they said it would be okay—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm so sorry...! Why didn't I pay 
proper attention...!”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry! Forgive me, my head is in a 
complete jumble right now—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I'll come to the trainer's room 
again tomorrow!

I couldn't call out to Dants Flame as she 
hurried away as if fleeing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Can I really quit? Even if I did, what 
about me—?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do?
(WOOOOOOOOO--!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go! Right there, pass them! 
Don't give up!! Keep pushing!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...— That voice... is it coming from the 
freestyle race track...?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, coming in...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Oooorrrryyyaaaaaaa!! Gaaahhhhhhhhhhhhh!! 
Taaahhhhhhhhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ngh, the heat is incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...W-Wah—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(The races were clumsy and rough, and 
sometimes there were near-fouls...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(The turf has clumps of grass sticking up, 
the stands are a mess, and there are 
barely any spectators. But...)

text_block_list.name: Confident Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I won! I won!! I am the strongest 
EVERRRR!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (It's just as passionate...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(My legs won't hold up in the Twinkle 
Series anymore. But here, maybe I can 
still run without breaking them.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Running a heated race together with 
everyone, entertaining the fans...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(If it's in this place, I can still be the 
leading——)

She wants to give up on the Twinkle Series 
and keep running in freestyle races 
instead.

The next day, Dants Flame came to me with 
such a request.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
――No matter what, no matter what happens, 
the one thing I never want to quit is 
racing...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Freestyle Races are wonderful 
too! They're unrefined, but full of 
dreams—!"

I understand very well how much you want 
to keep racing. However—
choice_data_list:
After everything... are you sure you're 
okay with that?

After everything... are you sure you're 
okay with that?

text_block_list.text:
"Giving up on competitive professional 
racing. Or continuing to race at the risk 
of worsening your injured leg."

"Might those eventually come to torment 
her?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
............ I... thought I understood, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
But racing has saved me so many times. 
...Th-That's why!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
In that place— please let me aim to be the 
star in freestyle racing once again!

"...There was one more thing that bothered 
me. Making freestyle races one's main 
battleground is not permitted at Tracen 
Academy."
choice_data_list:
I might not be able to support you 
anymore, either.

I might not be able to support you 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...T-That's— Um...

...Judging by the look of things, they're 
probably still in the midst of massive 
confusion. What needs to be done right now 
is—

Circumstances might change. As insurance, 
remain enrolled at the academy without 
erasing your URA registration for a while 
longer.

I told her that either way, I wouldn't 
terminate our trainer contract, and that 
she should focus completely on 
recuperating for a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Trainer, you're always... 
really—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Kh, I am terribly sorry for causing you 
so much trouble.

Having known her for about two and a half 
years, I'd like to think I understand her 
reasonably well.

The scenery behind those eyes... surely, 
there is only one.
choice_data_list:
(I'll watch over them until they sort out 
their feelings.)

text_block_list.text:
To continue racing... Days were spent 
scouring endlessly for a treatment method 
that could hopefully cure her completely—
